threshold_name: Ensures workers earn at least the local minimum wage after costs
reason: Both criteria are required. On-time payment is partly met and depends on which pay model applies; the wage floor is not met and is expressly disclaimed.

threshold_name: Ensures workers earn at least a local living wage after costs
reason: No evidence, and unreachable because 1.1 is not reached.
All three are required. Lone-working mitigation is partly met and is the strongest evidence in the corpus; equipment and training, and protection from accident costs, are both not met.

threshold_name: Ensures safe working conditions and a safety net
reason: All three are required. One is partly met, one has no evidence, one is not met. Unreachable in any case because 2.1 is not reached.

threshold_name: Provides clear and transparent terms and conditions
reason: All six are required. Two are met outright — the contracting party and informed consent — and two are partly met. The consumer-status waiver alone withholds the point.

threshold_name: Ensures that no unfair contract terms are imposed
reason: All four are required and none is met. Unreachable in any case because 3.1 is not reached.

threshold_name: Provides due process for decisions affecting workers
reason: All four are required. One is met, two are partly met, and one is contradicted by the driver contract. The contradiction alone withholds the point.

threshold_name: Provides equity in the management process
reason: All five are required. Two are partly met, two have no evidence, one is not met. Unreachable because 4.1 is not reached.

threshold_name: Assures freedom of association and the expression of worker voice
reason: All three are required. One is partly met, one has no evidence at all, one is contradicted.
At least one is required. One is partly met and one has no evidence. Unreachable because 5.1 is not reached.
